notes.text: The About Us page states 67,000 MVA annual capacity across six facilities, and says a second Chihuahua plant began operations in October 2022. Checked 15 Oct 2026.

On 11 July 2026 Transformer Magazine reported an agreement to take a majority stake in COMEL Transformatori, and wrote that the deal would add manufacturing capacity to the European network. Closing is expected in the second half of 2026.
